svg.desc: Schema, filters, sorting and record inspection reinforce one shared sense of place.. Design proposal, not a runtime screenshot. All dataset values and counts are synthetic illustrations. See README for capability boundaries and sources.
svg.text: 02 / The dataset stays at the center
Schema, filters, sorting and record inspection reinforce one shared sense of place.
DESIGN GUIDANCE ONLY • synthetic data • no runtime changes • sources and acceptance notes in README.md
Rows 1–8 of 12 · logical row identity retained
Prev / Next step through immediate visible neighbours.
One row, not a second dataset
Logical row identity survives filtering, sorting and edits.
Enter / double-click opens the full-depth inspector.
NULL is explicit; nested cells show bounded previews.
Do not imply range selection or bulk paste is shipped.
Compose field / operator / typed value; show removable chips.
Announce Filtering… / Sorting…; show a real empty result.
03 Keep the keyboard in the loop
Visible cell focus; arrow navigation; copy focused display value.
Row jumps focus the grid and announce the base row number.
